device.model: Programmable DC power supply (DCsupply_1, channels 2 and 3)
device.name: Programmable DC power supply (PowerSupply_Automation.py, DCsupply_1)

facts.text: The clone is a script of module-level functions: it opens three VISA resources and a Modbus client at import time, before any function is called
SUPPLY_CHANNEL_MAP maps S1 to powerSupply_1 channel 2 and S2 to powerSupply_1 channel 3
Set_Voltage selects the channel with INST:NSEL and writes VOLT
Set_Current selects the channel with INST:NSEL and writes CURR
Get_Voltage selects the channel with INST:NSEL and queries MEAS:VOLT?
Get_Current selects the channel with INST:NSEL and queries MEAS:CURR?
ON_OFF_Voltage selects the channel, accepts only ON or OFF and writes OUTP with that state
DEFAULT_VOLTAGE = 13.6 V and DEFAULT_CURRENT_LIMIT = 0.1 A are the starting profile of initialize_supplies; the comment says they can be changed
The README calls 13.6 V and 0.1 A default test parameters that can be changed before a new batch
shutdown_supplies turns every mapped channel off through ON_OFF_Voltage
The README maps five MCU samples S1-S5 onto three supplies
The chamber temperature is read from a Modbus holding register, not from the supply
The README says the temperature is a Modbus holding register value divided by 10.0
